title: Rutland Dry Mix Refractory Mortar, Masonry & Fire Brick Cement, No Heat Cure Required, Dark Gray, 2550F, 2.5 lb Tub
description:
About this item
Refractory mortar that is ideal for joining or repairing fire brick and masonry flue tile in any gas or wood fireplace and wood, coal, or pellet stove chimney
Needs to be mixed with water. Mix 2.5 lbs of dry mortar to 8 oz of water
Will cure completely by being exposed to air, and does not require a heat cure
Can be used outdoors and can be painted once dry
Made in the USA
